dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's from my cousin Kwan. She's getting married next month, and she invited me to the wedding!
dialogue.reading: ɪts frəm maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn. ʃiːz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmærid ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ, ənd ʃiː ɪnˈvaɪtɪd miː tə ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How exciting! How long has she known her future husband?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ! ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæz ʃiː ˈnoʊn hɜːr ˈfjuːtʃər ˈhʌzbənd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They've known each other since 2015. They met at university.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪv ˈnoʊn ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər sɪns ˈtwɛnti ˌfɪfˈtiːn. ðeɪ ˈmɛt ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a long time! When did he propose?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm! ˈwɛn dɪd hiː prəˈpoʊz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He proposed last year, on their anniversary. Have you ever been to a Thai wedding, Emma?
dialogue.reading: hiː prəˈpoʊzd ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ɑːn ðɛr ˌænɪˈvɜːrsəri. hæv juː ˈɛvər bɪn tə ə ˈtaɪ ˈwɛdɪŋ, ˈɛmə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I went to a friend's wedding in May. The bride changed her dress three times!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. aɪ ˈwɛnt tə ə ˈfrɛndz ˈwɛdɪŋ ɪn ˈmeɪ. ðə ˈbraɪd ˈtʃeɪndʒd hɜːr ˈdrɛs ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's common. The bride usually wears a traditional Thai dress in the morning and a white dress in the evening.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈkɑːmən. ðə ˈbraɪd ˈjuːʒuəli ˈwɛrz ə trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈtaɪ ˈdrɛs ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ənd ə ˈwaɪt ˈdrɛs ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My aunt is getting married again next year. She got divorced five years ago.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈænt ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmærid əˈɡɛn ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr. ʃiː ˈɡɑːt dɪˈvɔːrst ˈfaɪv ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's great news! Weddings are always happy days.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt ˈnuːz! ˈwɛdɪŋz ər ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhæpi ˈdeɪz.
